correctness.rationale: The coatom maps are uniquely parametrized by an adjacent merged kernel pair and an omitted image value. The inverse criterion is proved from ordered transversal sections and tested by direct function composition for all pairs for n=4..10. Nonidempotents split into two opposite triangular sets; the explicit involution exchanges them. Any alternative fixed-idempotent matching induces a coordinatewise nondecreasing self-bijection of a finite set, which must be identity by summation, proving uniqueness. Exact perfect matching counts 1 were computed independently for n=4..8. Finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The highest nonunit Green class is a natural canonical stratum whose inverse-matchings are implicated by current existence theorems. A unique idempotent-fixing involution determines the entire matching (all 2(n-1) fixed points and C(n-1,2) pairs) in that stratum for infinitely many monoids, a structural rigidity theorem and a constraint for any future global idempotent-fixing construction. It is not a mere numerical instance or a reparametrized existence corollary, though it does not solve the global involution question.
